product.name: Vitamix Propel Series 750 Professional-Grade Blender, 4 Programs, Black | 64 oz. Container, Kitchen Appliance for Smoothies, Soups and More, Pulse, Variable Speed, Self-Cleaning Program
features: Included: Propel Series 750 blender motor base, 64-ounce low-profile container, and low-profile tamper; this low-profile kitchen blender container allows for large-capacity blends while still fitting under kitchen cabinets

Four Blending Programs: Four automatic Blending Programs for Smoothie, Hot Soup, Frozen Dessert, and Dip & Spread, for consistent results; achieve precise textures with 10 variable speed settings and a Pulse Function for ice crushing
Self-Cleaning Program: Just add warm water, a drop of dish soap, and run the Self-Cleaning Program; the blender will clean itself in 60 seconds or less
2.2 HP Motor: Equipped with a high-performance motor, this countertop blender lets you say goodbye to chunky smoothies and hello to effortless blends
Stainless-Steel Blades: Laser-cut, stainless-steel blades can power through fibrous produce and frozen fruit, crush ice and nuts, and much more, offering consistent blends for years

64-Ounce Container: The BPA-free, dishwasher-safe blending container is designed to create the iconic Vitamix Vortex; it's a professional-grade blender for smoothies, juices, purées, sauces, soups, and more, making hot and cold dishes in the container

7-Year Limited Warranty: Backed by Vitamix’s industry-leading warranty, Propel 750 is designed to deliver reliable performance and peace of mind; Vitamix blenders last up to 10x longer than an average blender
